name: Rediscovering the Light
summary: In Deathknell, newly raised Forsaken paladins face the pain of calling on the Holy Light. Aramis Hammerhand teaches them to heal wounded Deathguards through the burning agony.

sections.title: A Painful Reunion
sections.body: Newly risen Forsaken paladins must face a hard truth: the Holy Light still answers them, but burns their withered bodies. Many were champions of the Silver Hand or knights of Lordaeron before they fell. Aramis Hammerhand teaches them that powers once used without thought now bring fierce pain. The Light clashes with the foul magic that sustains undeath, so calling on it takes resolve and endurance.

sections.title: Purification Through Suffering
sections.body: Deathguards in Deathknell suffer grievous wounds fighting mindless zombies, and Forsaken paladins are called to heal them. Aramis teaches that pushing through the burning pain is like exercising an atrophied muscle. The paladins treat that agony as a badge of honor and proof that the Light has not forsaken them.

faq.q: Why does using the Light hurt Forsaken paladins?
faq.answer: The Holy Light opposes the necrotic energies that sustain undeath. A Forsaken's will and conviction let them channel it, but sacred energy moving through dead flesh brings burning pain.
Aramis Hammerhand is an undead paladin trainer in Deathknell. He guides newly risen Forsaken paladins as they rebuild their connection to the Holy Light.

faq.q: Why are the Deathguards in Deathknell injured?
faq.answer: Deathguard soldiers are wounded while defending Deathknell from mindless undead, feral Scourge remnants, and hostile wildlife around the settlement, as the newly risen awaken from their graves.

faq.q: Can undead naturally wield the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Yes. Undead can wield the Holy Light if they retain faith, willpower, and the memory of their former vows. The Light answers genuine conviction, though it exacts a brutal physical toll on dead bodies.

faq.q: What does Aramis mean when he calls pain a badge of honor?
faq.answer: Aramis sees the burning agony as proof that the Light still listens, not as a curse. Forsaken paladins endure the searing heat of their spells to show their loyalty and purpose.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: It takes place entirely in Deathknell, the secluded haven in southwestern Tirisfal Glades where newly raised Forsaken first emerge into undeath.

angles.text: For an undead paladin, reconnecting with the Light tests faith and endurance. Holy vows can survive death, though the Light brings blistering agony.
As an Undead, you show the Forsaken's fierce resilience, turning the Light's searing torment into a disciplined weapon for survival.
